name: Walker
author: brodgar
description: Write-actions demo — a small, DORMANT, opt-in addon that DECLARES the 'actions' permission (hafen.act, the one part of hafen.* that DRIVES the character). Write-actions are a PER-ADDON permission (D-027/D-028): there is NO global switch — it is therefore DISABLED BY DEFAULT when first discovered (opt-in per addon). To use it, enable it in Options > AddOns and CONFIRM the consent dialog (it can act on your behalf), then Reload UI: it logs at login that write-actions are GRANTED, and ':walker' deliberately walks you ~2 tiles south via hafen.act.moveTo. Leave it disabled (the default) and it never acts. Kept SEPARATE from the read-only 'hello' regression harness (which declares no permissions).
